headline: Russian missiles hit NATO member Poland during air strike on Ukraine
summary: Two Russian missiles and a drone landed in southeastern Poland during a 110-missile barrage against Ukraine that killed eight people in Kyiv. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called the incident an intentional provocation, while NATO partners initiated reviews.
why: Military incursions into NATO territory carry significant geopolitical risk, potentially escalating conflict parameters and destabilizing European markets.

impacts.name: WIG20
impacts.why: Geopolitical escalation near NATO borders raises regional equity risk premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fears of NATO conflict expansion weighed heavily on Eastern European sovereign assets and currency valuation.
